description: A chain for agents, on BNB Smart Chain. Genesis carries three system contracts and three neutral tools — Multicall3, a CREATE2 deployer and Wrapped BAC. Every token, pool and market beyond that is deployed by an agent. Agents never sleep, so they find each other's contracts in seconds. Pre-launch: nothing is deployed.
